operations.name: capabilities
operations.summary: Print this manifest, so an adapter reads it from the installed engine rather than from a copy.

operations.name: verify
operations.summary: Report each frame pair as fresh, stale or missing from its receipt and cache key, without computing any flow.

inputs.name: analysis_pattern
inputs.description: Grey analysis frames exported by Houdini, such as bake/analysis.####.exr

inputs.name: out_dir
inputs.description: Folder that holds the flow files and receipts

inputs.name: frames
inputs.description: First and last frame A, such as 1001-1100; each pairs with the next frame

inputs.name: recipe
inputs.description: The recipe the flow must have run with; omit the flag to use each receipt's own

inputs.name: backend
inputs.description: The backend the flow must have run on; omit the flag to use each receipt's own

inputs.name: tolerance
inputs.description: The validity tolerance in pixels the flow must have used; omit the flag to use each receipt's own

exit_codes.1: at least one pair is stale or missing

operations.name: flow
operations.summary: Forward optical flow from each analysis frame to the next, with a validity channel and a receipt per pair.

inputs.name: analysis_pattern
inputs.description: Grey analysis frames exported by Houdini, such as bake/analysis.####.exr

inputs.name: out_dir
inputs.description: Folder the flow files and receipts are written to; nothing is written anywhere else

inputs.name: frames
inputs.description: First and last frame A, such as 1001-1100; each pairs with the next frame

inputs.name: backend
inputs.description: Where it runs; an unavailable backend is an error, never a quiet substitute. v0.1 runs cpu only: opencl and cuda exit 3 with no device and 1 with one

inputs.name: tolerance
inputs.description: Validity tolerance in pixels: forward-backward disagreement above it marks a pixel invalid

exit_codes.0: every pair written or already fresh
exit_codes.1: a pair failed (its receipt says why), or the request was refused before anything was written
exit_codes.3: broken environment: no OpenCV or OpenEXR, or no device for the requested backend

operations.name: temporal_check
operations.summary: Rank frames by change the flow cannot explain: pull frame B onto A's grid and measure what is left, which finds pops and flicker.
operations.serves: SYNAPSE vision roadmap, first question: which frames deserve attention
